notes: Chart layers already agree (Xerath on all seven rows, both layers, matching packet) — no chart edits. spikes[0].text slot fix: Eye of Destruction is Xerath's W, not E; suspectNames correctly flagged it. The page claims Xerath Q outranges Flash Frost — the kit lists Q at 750 vs her 1075, but Xerath's Q charge-up extension is not in Riot's text, so the claim was left untouched and is recorded as unverified rather than 'corrected' into a new error. Flash Frost cancelling Xerath's R channel (missingInteractions, hardCC vs interruptible channel) is real but report[5] is not lint-flagged and the sweep excludes report[]; surfacing here: only channel R when her Q is down or from beyond its 1075 line. Rebirth egg: content already covers pre-aiming the revive. Ratings untouched. sectionsMissing: enemyWin, breakdown.carry, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.late remain structurally templated; nothing Anivia-specific fit their bands without invention.
